purpose: Fresh V5 intended foreign phonetic contrasts after the V4 holdout became diagnostic. No audio before a new passed-calibration lock; no language-identity negative labels.
homophonePolicy: Do not label a sound incorrect merely because it was spoken in another language or dialect. Use only explicit phonetic contrasts to the configured targets; apparent homophones require adjudication or remain unavailable.
